policy.selection: both final searches exact finite cp, completed depth minimum, same legal best move, absolute cp difference within threshold; use final label only
policy.all_stages: mate, bound, missing score/depth/nodes/PV, non-exhausted budget or mate-range cp at any stage excludes the training label
policy.stronger_than_original: final requested node budget must exceed original teacher reported nodes
policy.context: new logical UCI game and Clear Hash for every position and budget; full original history; no time limit
policy.teacher: own Regicide; complete classical HCE; neural off; positional, pawn shield, pawn structure, quiescence and existing search options enabled
policy.holdout: never search, relabel, filter or reserialize validation/test rows
policy.uncertainty: finite-search agreement is not ground truth, optimal-play proof or evidence of playing strength

reserved_arena_guard.scope: reject train game histories starting from reserved prefixes and explicit reserved/arena provenance; caller must never disguise arena evidence as learning data

checkout.scope: collector checkout only; not proof of executable build origin
